audit.why: Even assassin duel (50.24% WR, 1053 games): Qiyana holds levels 1 through first item, Ekko takes over at 2+ items via W stun, E dash and Chronobreak resets. Content layer already tells this arc.
Spikes accurate: pre-6 walk-up edge (his W stun needs the zone to arm), level 6 gated on Chronobreak's cooldown, first item out-bursts pre-Zhonya's Ekko, 2+ items flips to him. Matches packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three missing interactions never stated: Parallel Convergence (W) shields Ekko when he enters the anomaly (absorbs the burst window); his combo opens with the Phase Dive (E) auto-reset wind-up (the step-back tell); Chronobreak (R) heals a percentage of damage taken (Grievous Wounds timing). spikes[0] also mislabels Phase Dive as defensive — it is his engage blink. Cooldowns field had no numbers.
audit.why: Riot kit: W 22s rank 1 with shield flag, E 9s with autoReset flag and teleport-to-target text, R 110/80/50 with heal flag. missingInteractions lists all three rules.
audit.corrected: W shield folded into dosFull[0].d; E auto-reset tell into spikes[0].text; Grievous timing into spikes[3].text; real cooldowns (110s/50s R, 9s E) into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Packet suspectName 'Arm Parallel Convergence' is a false positive — Parallel Convergence is the real W name and 'arm' is the verb; wants.foe[0] left alone.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Terrashape (element swap) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1, only 50s at rank 3. It erases your kill and bursts back; track the hologram and save final damage for after it. - Phase Dive (E) is a 9s cooldown: that is your dive window. - Your 120s R goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: His W anomaly shields and stuns once he enters it — ice-Q root the Phase Dive commit before it arms, and his all-in maths collapses.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: His passive needs three hits on the same target — grass stealth drops his lock mid-trade, so the third-hit burst never lands.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Open ground lets Timewinder hit both ways and Phase Dive roll free — his combo works there; yours needs a hedge.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: Two-item Ekko rewinds your all-in — W shield-stun and Chronobreak eat the single commit and out-teamfight you.

edits.before: Pre-6 you out-trade him: Ekko's Timewinder (Q) is his only poke and his W (Parallel Convergence) stun needs 3 full seconds inside the zone to arm. Sidestep his Q, walk up when W isn't planted, and W-E-Q burst him. His Phase Dive (E) is defensive, so bait it before you commit your own E.
edits.after: Pre-6 you out-trade him: Ekko's Timewinder (Q) is his only poke and his W (Parallel Convergence) stun needs 3 full seconds inside the zone to arm. Sidestep his Q, walk up when W isn't planted, and W-E-Q burst him. His combo opens with Phase Dive's auto-reset wind-up — step back on the wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: This is where he pulls ahead. Two-item Ekko with W stun, E dash and especially Chronobreak can eat your entire all-in and rewind to full, turning a lost fight into a kill on you. His teamfight AoE and self-peel outscale your single commit.
edits.after: This is where he pulls ahead. Two-item Ekko with W stun and E dash eats your all-in, and Chronobreak's heal rewinds him toward full — buy Grievous Wounds before it if he snowballs. His teamfight AoE and self-peel outscale your single commit.
